mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_pick_task (task_no, wave_id, outbound_id, allocation_id, sku_id, from_location_id, sequence, required_qty, status) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{waveId}, #{outboundId}, #{allocationId}, #{skuId}, #{fromLocationId}, #{sequence}, #{requiredQty}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_pick_task SET picked_qty = picked_qty + #{delta}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
